description: Low-level Solana copy trade update (prefer update_copy_trade_settings / pause_copy_trade / resume_copy_trade / delete_copy_trade). Every field is rewritten from this payload, so pass the full current config. isDelete=true permanently deletes the configuration; positions it opened are NOT sold and their TP/SL limit orders are NOT cancelled. isChangeStatus=true TOGGLES active/paused relative to the stored state (sending it twice resumes). isDelete and isChangeStatus cannot both be true.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

buyMode.description: 1 = fixed SOL amount, 2 = percentage of trader amount

isBuyExistingToken.description: Buy tokens the trader already holds

isChangeStatus.description: Toggle active/paused relative to the stored state

isDelete.description: Permanently delete the configuration (positions stay open)

name: update_copy_trade
